statement: Open holds are capped at 32 and the 33rd is refused with too_many_holds; a dispute proof with more reverts (E10), and a proof body carries the transformers of every token, so the decided rule counts open holds across every token of the Account. The ts cell holds both halves: the per-token check (ledger.ts) and the Account-level count (state.ts, applied by tx.ts).
source: Review B of PR 73; contracts Account.sol MAX_DISPUTE_TRANSFORMERS = 32; Quint LOCK_SLOTS

killers.name: R-HOLD-CAP at most 32 holds are open, matching the contract's proof bound
R-HOLD-CAP two tokens with 16 holds each: a 33rd lock in either token is refused
R-HOLD-CAP a token that holds 32 alone refuses its own 33rd, and the other token is refused too
R-HOLD-CAP a hold that resolves, cancels or expires frees its place in the count, in any token
